In addition, the provisions of Article VI, Chapter 5 (Special Regulations Applying in Designated Recovery Areas) and Section 64-61 (Special Provisions for Non-conforming Uses) shall not apply.

blocks.html: Non-conforming uses may not be enlarged or extended. In addition, should 50 percent or more of the floor area of a building containing a non-conforming use be damaged or destroyed after September 7, 2017, the building may be repaired, incidentally altered or reconstructed only for a conforming use.
